def transform(grid):
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def groups(indices):
        out=[]
        for i in indices:
            if not out or i > out[-1][-1] + 1:
                out.append([i])
            else:
                out[-1].append(i)
        return out
    rg = [g for g in groups([r for r in range(R) if any(grid[r][c] for c in range(C))]) if len(g)==3]
    cg = [g for g in groups([c for c in range(C) if any(grid[r][c] for r in range(R))]) if len(g)==3]
    blocks = []
    for rs in rg:
        for cs in cg:
            b = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
            if all(v != 0 for row in b for v in row):
                blocks.append(b)
    for b in blocks:
        if len(set(v for row in b for v in row)) == 3:
            return b
    return blocks[0] if blocks else []
PY
